# SecLists (fixture)

SecLists is the security tester's companion. It is a collection of multiple
types of lists used during security assessments, collected in one place.
List types include usernames, passwords, URLs, sensitive data patterns,
fuzzing payloads, web shells, and many more.

This fixture is synthetic: every entry below is invented and points at
`example.test`. It models the upstream README's section-and-link style.

## Discovery

- [DNS Subdomains](https://example.test/seclists/discovery/dns-subdomains.txt) - subdomain wordlist for DNS brute-forcing
- [Web Content](https://example.test/seclists/discovery/web-content.txt) - common web files and directories
- [raft-medium-directories](https://example.test/seclists/discovery/raft-medium-directories.txt)
- snmp-communities.txt - plain file reference without a link

## Passwords

- [Common Passwords](https://example.test/seclists/passwords/common-passwords.txt) - passwords ordered by frequency
- [Common Passwords Mirror](https://EXAMPLE.test/seclists/passwords/common-passwords.txt) - mirror of the entry above

- [Default Usernames](https://example.test/seclists/usernames/default-usernames.txt) - vendor default accounts
